newsitem.title: GHANA: Ghana stocks close slightly lower.
newsitem.headline: Ghana stocks close slightly lower.

text.p: Ghanaian stocks slipped on Friday, closing another indifferent week during which offers once again consistently outstripped demand.
The GSE All-Share Index fell 1.58 points to 365.74 from Wednesday's 367.32.
Offers outstripped demand by 1,042,490 shares to 251,780 -- continuing the trend of recent months. A total of 85,940 shares changed hands, up from Wednesday's 33,360 and 31,320 on Monday.
Dealers said investors were more interested in attractively priced government bonds, issued as part of a campaign to curb inflation.
